channel.title: Kiki Updates
channel.description: Developer ID signed and notarized updates for Kiki.

item.description:
# Kiki 0.5.14
- Makes Waveform mode fully transparent so the animated signal floats without a panel, border, or box shadow. - Adds a flat adaptive keyline behind each bar to keep the waveform readable over both light and dark content. - Leaves Full Transcript and status messages contained for readability. - Adds a regression check that keeps the Waveform surface transparent and prevents the adaptive keyline from disappearing.

# Kiki 0.5.13
- Replaces the Listening Display's seven-dot meter with a wide, animated 38-bar waveform. - Uses a logarithmic microphone meter so quiet and conversational speech create visible movement instead of remaining nearly flat. - Adds fast attack, natural decay, scrolling history, and a restrained sage-to-khaki live edge. - Keeps Waveform mode compact while making its response clearly readable in both light and dark appearances. - Adds signal-response diagnostics and a dedicated packaged waveform preview for visual release checks.

# Kiki 0.5.12
- Removes the distracting radial glare that repeated across cards and panels. - Removes the synthetic grain texture from shared card surfaces. - Replaces both effects with a restrained matte treatment: subtle vertical depth, a hairline inner edge, and a softer shadow. - Keeps the same card geometry and Studio Hardware colors in light and dark appearances. - Adds a regression check that prevents the radial-glare and texture layers from returning.

# Kiki 0.5.11
- Matches the active Models meter to the approved Studio Hardware mockup, including its narrowed arch, angled end ticks, sage markings, and compact scale. - Corrects hardware-button typography and label padding across the Models page. - Gives every shared card the same shaded, dimensional, subtly textured Studio Hardware surface in both light and dark appearances. - Removes the decorative corner rivets from Models, Settings, Voice Studio, and What’s New cards. - Adds regression checks for the shared card-depth layers and compact hardware-control typography.

# Kiki 0.5.10
- Reconstructs the Models cards from the approved Studio Hardware mockup at the component level. - Matches the 440-by-109 active module, 72-point dial bay, compact hardware button, top-only brass screws, and boxed analog meter. - Restores the mockup's typography, text wrapping, neutral charcoal surfaces, subtle hardware shading, and compact spacing. - Keeps the Models geometry identical in light and dark appearances while changing only the theme colors. - Adds regression checks for the exact active-card, dial, meter, divider, control-bay, and button dimensions. - Makes the packaged preview exercise the real model-selection callback so model buttons can be interaction-tested before publication.
